    "Many animal experiments are poorly designed, conducted and analysed.",
    "Reviews and summaries of evidence from animal research are methodologically inadequate.",
    "Major methodological limitations of the animal research.",
    "Evidence of widespread publication bias.",
    "Disparate animal species and strains, with a variety of metabolic pathways and drug metabolites, leading to variation in efficacy and toxicity.",
    "Different models for inducing illness or injury, with varying similarity to the human condition.",
    "Variations in drug dosing schedules and regimens of uncertain relevance to the human condition.",

    "Only 1/10,000 Medline records of animal studies were tagged as being meta-analyses compared with 1/1000 human studies.",
    "Only 25 systematic reviews of animal research were found in a comprehensive search of Medline.",
    "30 and 57 systematic reviews of any type of animal research were found in other recent studies.",
    "In one systematic review of FK506, 29 animal studies were found.",
    "Only one of the 29 FK506 animal studies had blinded investigators.",
    "Only two of the 29 FK506 animal studies had blinded observers during outcome assessment.",
    "None of the 29 FK506 animal studies met all 10 quality criteria applied by the reviewers.",
    "The highest score for FK506 animal studies was 7 out of 10 quality criteria.",
    "Meta-analysis of FK506 studies demonstrated a strong trend for the methodologically weakest studies to show the strongest protective effects.",
    "Methodologically strongest FK506 studies showed either no or weak protective effects."
